name: Throne Integration
author: WolfyMaster LLC
description: Receives Throne webhooks and fires a trigger when someone buys an item from your Throne wishlist.

triggers.name: Throne webhook
triggers.description: The public URL to paste into Throne's webhook settings. Verifies each request and turns it into Throne events.

triggers.name: Throne item purchased
triggers.description: Fires when someone buys an item from your Throne wishlist.

fields.description: Price of the item, in the currency below.
Who bought it. Empty when the gift is anonymous.
The note the gifter left, if any.

settings.label: Throne Webhook Secret
settings.description: The signing secret from Throne's webhook settings. Requests without a valid signature are rejected.
